sentences.text: The only known specimen, the holotype — the single specimen the species is based on — ZDM 0193, is a partial skeleton of a juvenile individual.
Based on this juvenile skeleton, adults of Daanosaurus are estimated to have reached 18 meters in length, 9 meters in height, and weighed 30 tonnes.
The genus name Daanosaurus means "Da'an lizard" and refers to the Da'an district in Sichuan, China, where fossils found in the Upper Shaximiao Formation were described in 2005.
The species name zhangi honors Zhang Aiping, the former Minister of National Defense, while the genus name refers to the Da'an district where fossils were found.
Daanosaurus was originally classified in the subfamily Bellusaurinae, which is part of the family Brachiosauridae.
Recent studies have placed Daanosaurus in the clade Macronaria based on opisthocoelous posterior dorsal vertebrae, a trait also found in mamenchisaurids.
The Paleobi Database lists the parent group of Daanosaurus as Mamenchisauridae.
Daanosaurus is considered by many to be a eusauropod due to its similarity to Bellusaurus.
Daanosaurus lived in Asia during the Late Jurassic, approximately 156 million years ago during the Oxfordian stage.
The time range for Daanosaurus is estimated from the Kimmeridgian to the Tithonian stages, between 154.8 and 143.1 million years ago.
Phylogenetic analysis suggests that Daanosaurus may be a mamenchisaurid, though this classification remains debated due to the juvenile nature of the fossil.
